notes.title: The Time Game Showdown
notes.content:
[p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013493/abae28d54a3a4d31f04cd7fd34497eea3ab138e4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Event starts at 6:30pm Pacific Daylight Time (GMT -8:00) Monday 28th of July and runs for 2 hours.[/p][p][/p][p]For players that would like to join in the fun.     Post "code" in our Showdown-event-lobby-codes discord channel for a lobby code that can be used to connect to a lobby in The Time Game Demo.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/qPmJx3y5vj"]This invite link[/url] is also on the Steam store page for those looking to join the Discord server.[/p][p][/p][p]This will be streamed live on our [url="https://www.youtube.com/@MeisterCards"]Youtube channel[/url] [/p][p][/p][p]Hope you all can make it for this unique event[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
